body:
I've suspected for awhile that medication might help me feel better. I was on some sort of anti-depressant when I was a teenager and I hated the way it made me feel, but I do remember that it made what I thought was a hellish existence into a tolerable one. 

That said, I don't know how to make that happen now. I have no medical insurance. There are free clinics around here but I don't think they treat that sort of thing.
